name: Alberta Adams (Allen)
personality: Characterized as the functional matriarch of the Adams family
notable_stories: Took responsibility for ensuring relatives were buried in the family plot in Marceline, Missouri

While signing her father John Wesley's death certificate, she mistakenly noted his father was born in Ohio, a detail that led future researchers to investigate a previously unknown Ohio branch of the family
The preparer concludes Alberta (Adams) Allen became matriarch of the Adams family and made sure family members were buried in Marceline.
milestones: Migrated to Colorado in a covered wagon with her husband in the late 1880s for health reasons
Returned to Marceline and eventually moved to Kansas in 1918
Buried at Mt. Olivet Cemetery, Marceline, MO
locations: Mt. Olivet Cemetery, Marceline, Linn County, MO
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Newspaper clippings and obituaries in Bill Allen’s family document (2011)
Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Siblings listed: Anna M., Charles W., Mary Susan, George Francis (#2), Gertrude, William W. (Full); Clay C. Clark (Half)
CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Removed allen_margaret_jeanice from children: born 1925, she is a granddaughter (daughter of George Philip Allen).
Photo caption 'Alberta Adams Allen'; also pictured with her husband in a caption 'George J. & Alberta Allen' [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 6028]

Informant who signed her father John W. Adams's death certificate. She stated his father George was born in Ohio, which the author believes was a mistake. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7358]
Alberta Adams was an older sister of George F. Adams (#2), and the Allen family descends from her. [Family research emails, email 38]

Unconfirmed: According to Bill Allen, Alberta filled in the parents' section of her father John W.'s death certificate and was probably guessing, since she hardly knew George F. and Cynthia Lane. [Family research emails, email 47]

Open question: Bill Allen says 'George Francis Adams SR.' was Alberta Adams Allen's younger brother and a son of John Wesley Adams. In the tree, Alberta's brother is George Francis Adams (#2), father of George Francis Adams Sr., who married Beryl Simons [Family research emails, email 26]
